skill.name: google-agents-cli-eval
skill.description: Guides coding agents through evaluating Google ADK agents with agents-cli. It covers datasets, metrics, grading, comparison, failure analysis, optimization, user simulation, builtin tools, and multimodal evaluation.
skill.summary: Guide Google ADK agent evaluation with agents-cli datasets, metrics, grading, comparison, and failure analysis.
skill.author: google

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced examples, and documentation links rather than executable skill code. The remaining medium-risk issue is documented local custom metric execution with the CLI process privileges. No prompt injection or secret exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Local custom metrics can execute Python with CLI privileges.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to review custom_function code, avoid untrusted metric configs, and prefer remote execution for untrusted evaluators.

content.user_title: Evaluate Google ADK Agents with agents-cli
content.value_statement: Agent teams need repeatable evidence before changing prompts, tools, or deployment settings. This skill guides dataset design, metric selection, grading, comparison, and failure analysis for Google ADK agents.
actual_capabilities: Explains the Quality Flywheel for preparing data, generating traces, grading results, analyzing failures, and improving agents.
Maps goals to built-in metrics such as task success, trajectory quality, tool use quality, hallucination, and safety.
Shows agents-cli eval commands for generating, grading, comparing, analyzing, synthesizing, optimizing, submitting, and fetching results.
Documents evaluation dataset shapes for single-turn prompts, multi-turn continuations, and complete traces.
Provides guidance for custom LLM and code-based metrics, including local and remote execution choices.
Covers builtin tool behavior, user simulation, and multimodal evaluation through reference files.
limitations: Requires agents-cli and a compatible Google agent project.
Does not scaffold, deploy, or write ADK application code.
Some commands may call managed evaluation services and require Google Cloud configuration.
Metric names and CLI flags can change; users should confirm with command help.

use_cases.title: Validate prompt changes
use_cases.description: Run generated traces and compare grade results before merging prompt or tool description updates.

use_cases.title: Build evaluation coverage
use_cases.description: Create datasets and select metrics that measure task success, tool behavior, safety, and hallucination risks.

use_cases.title: Review cloud eval workflows
use_cases.description: Use managed submit and results flows when local grading is too small for production-scale testing.

prompt_templates.title: Choose metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: I am evaluating a [type] ADK agent. Help me choose built-in agents-cli eval metrics and explain what each metric will catch.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a dataset plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evaluation plan for these user goals: [goals]. Include case types, expected evidence, and common dataset mistakes to avoid.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these grade result symptoms: [symptoms]. Identify likely root causes and suggest agent or dataset changes before the next eval run.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize the eval loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an advanced Quality Flywheel workflow for [agent]. Include dataset synthesis, metric selection, comparison gates, and when to use prompt optimization.

output_examples.input: A user asks which metrics to use for a customer support agent.
output: Recommend task success for complete issue resolution.
Add tool use quality to verify case lookup and escalation calls.
Use hallucination and safety metrics for grounded, compliant responses.

output_examples.input: A user reports that tool use quality dropped after a prompt change.
output: Inspect the latest grade report for failed rubric items.
Compare the failed trace with the previous passing trace.
Update tool descriptions or routing instructions, then rerun generate and grade.

output_examples.input: A user wants to test an agent that handles image inputs.
output: Use multimodal dataset guidance from the reference file.
Select a vision-capable judge for image-aware scoring.
Avoid text-only metrics when the original media must be evaluated.

best_practices: Start with a small dataset, fix failures, then expand coverage after passing cases are stable.
Use comparison runs to confirm a change improves the target metric without regressing other metrics.
Prefer remote sandbox execution for untrusted code-based custom metrics.
anti_patterns: Lowering thresholds to make an agent pass instead of fixing behavior.
Deleting flaky cases without diagnosing non-determinism or unclear rubrics.
Running expensive optimization loops before manual fixes and targeted eval evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill run evaluations by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides the AI assistant and user through agents-cli eval workflows and commands.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it replace official command help?
faq.answer: No. It tells users to check agents-cli help because flags can change.

faq.question: Can it handle multimodal evaluations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for image, audio, file, and video evaluation patterns.

faq.question: Does it require cloud services?
faq.answer: Local generate and grade flows can run locally, but synthesize, submit, results, and some metrics use managed services.

faq.question: What security care is needed?
faq.answer: Do not run untrusted local custom metric code. Use remote sandbox execution or review code before grading.
